# LAist

> > LAist is Southern California's NPR member station delivering local and national news, public affairs programming, and cultural coverage through shows like AirTalk with Larry Mantle.

The site features a mix of NPR national news coverage and locally-produced content focused on Southern California issues, politics, health, and culture. Archive content includes extensive 2004 election coverage, Iraq War reporting, and public affairs discussions.

## Key Topics

- NPR News
- Southern California
- AirTalk
- Larry Mantle
- Iraq War
- 2004 Presidential Election
- Political Analysis
- John Kerry
- Bush Administration
- Health & Medicine
- Cultural Affairs
- Congressional Coverage
- Terrorism
- Haiti Crisis
- Public Radio

## National Politics & Elections

- [Political Talk with Cokie Roberts: Campaign Analysis](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/political-talk-with-cokie-roberts-campaign-analysis): Cokie Roberts analyzes Super Tuesday and Kerry-Edwards Democratic race
- [Post-Election Special](https://laist.com/shows/airtalk/post-election-special): Political experts analyze Super Tuesday results with Larry Mantle
- [Analysis: Democrats' Media Messages](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/analysis-democrats-media-messages): NPR analyzes Kerry and Edwards' personal branding in campaign ads
- [Kerry Defends Clarke](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/kerry-defends-clarke): Kerry supports Richard Clarke's criticism of Bush Iraq-terrorism focus
- [Election-Year Politics Complicate Budget Debate](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/election-year-politics-complicate-budget-debate): Andrea Seabrook covers politicized fiscal 2005 budget debate in House

## Iraq War & Military Coverage

- [Iraq Update: One Year Later](https://laist.com/shows/airtalk/iraq-update-one-year-later): AirTalk: Time's Vivian Walt on Iraq one year after with Larry Mantle
- [House Debate Erupts over Iraq Policy](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/house-debate-erupts-over-iraq-policy): NPR's Andrea Seabrook covers fierce House debate over Iraq resolution
- [The Iraq War: The Marines' View from the Ground](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/the-iraq-war-the-marines-view-from-the-ground): Jackie Northam shares field historians' combat interviews with Marines
- [GIs Leave Cultural Imprint on Iraq](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/gis-leave-cultural-imprint-on-iraq): Ivan Watson reports on American cultural influence in pre-transfer Iraq
- [Finding a Balance at 'Stars and Stripes'](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/finding-a-balance-at-stars-and-stripes): Bob Edwards examines Stars and Stripes' editorial independence struggle

## International News

- [Bombs Kill Nearly 200 in Madrid](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/bombs-kill-nearly-200-in-madrid): Jerome Socolovsky reports on coordinated Madrid train bombings in Spain
- [Turmoil In Haiti](https://laist.com/shows/airtalk/turmoil-in-haiti): Time's Tim Padgett discusses Aristide's departure and Haiti's future
- [Haiti's Dark Secret: The Restavecs](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/haitis-dark-secret-the-restavecs): Rachel Leventhal documents Haiti's 300,000 child domestic servants

## Health & Science

- [Genetic Testing, Part 2: Reading Genes for Disease](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/genetic-testing-part-2-reading-genes-for-disease): NPR's Joe Palca explores genetic testing decisions with cystic fibrosis case
- [Cancer News With City Of Hope's Dr. Michael Friedman](https://laist.com/shows/airtalk/cancer-news-with-city-of-hopes-dr-michael-friedman): Dr. Friedman discusses latest cancer research from oncology conference
- [Dramatic Benefit Found in Low Cholesterol](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/dramatic-benefit-found-in-low-cholesterol): NPR's Richard Knox reports on statin study reducing heart attack risk

## Southern California Culture & Arts

- [Southland Fifties Nostalgia](https://laist.com/shows/airtalk/southland-fifties-nostalgia): Charles Phoenix's Kodachrome tour of Southern California 1940s-60s
- [Pasadena's Cultural Plan](https://laist.com/shows/airtalk/pasadenas-cultural-plan): Cultural Nexus chair discusses Pasadena's arts and cultural planning

## Optional

- [Study: Public Losing Trust in Media](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/study-public-losing-trust-in-media): Center for Excellence in Journalism study shows declining media trust
- [House Bans Some Food Lawsuits](https://laist.com/news/npr-news/house-bans-some-food-lawsuits): House passes 'cheeseburger bill' limiting obesity lawsuit liability
